item.title: DOOM SCROLL // RECOVERED TRANSMISSION 002
item.description:
I'd rather doom scroll my memories
It's a lot more taxing on my ego
Yours takes the edge off
Mine cuts to the bone
I like to see it
I'm data mining myself
Pickaxe in my own skull
Panning for the parts they kept

// 3EAS_CORTEX :: RECOVERED_TRANSMISSION_002

Signal found on a cracked phone
left face-up on a nightstand
screen still lit
thumb print smeared across the glass
like a fingerprint at a crime scene
The feed was still scrolling on its own
No one was holding it
The file was signed 3EAS CORTEX
half human
half white hat code
breaking into the feed
to give back what was taken

// PROTOCOL_COMPARISON
Ether or Ethernet
The tools are similar
One spoke through smoke
One speaks through glass
Same priests
Same tithe
Different altar

!! ERROR_CORRUPTED_PLAYBACK
It's fascinating
The transmitted version of me
Gets served back
As Asian ass
Whiny conspiracy bros
And the lunch menus
Of women I once tried to fuck
That's not my past
That's my past
With ads in it
They cut my memory
With filler
Like a dealer cuts the bag

!! WARNING_SUBJECT_PROFILE_DETECTED
The algorithm built a version of me
Out of what I lingered on
Sold it back to me
And called it a recommendation
A mirror bought at auction
Glass coated in their silver

// REM_CYCLE_INTERCEPTED
I dreamt of a hallway of faces
Each one a door
That opened only if I pulled left
Behind every door
The same empty chair
Still warm

A stranger came
Summoned by a glowing pin
Three hundred feet away
She knew my body
From a photo
Taken in better light
We spoke in emojis
Then in no language at all
And when she left
She took a copy of me
Uploaded before sunrise
Her face dissolving
Into a grid of other faces
All of them
Three hundred feet away

Another stranger knocked at two a.m.
Holding a paper bag
That smelled like my mother's kitchen
He wouldn't say his name
He only said
You always order this
When the moon is like this

I got into a car with no driver
It already knew the way
Past the house I grew up in
Past the house I shouldn't have left
Past your window
Where the light was still on
The meter running in a currency
I couldn't read

Then a soft voice
Asked how I was feeling
On a scale of one to five
I said five
It wrote down one
And somewhere in a room I'll never see
A man in a clean suit
Smiled at my sadness
Like a harvest

I woke up rated
Four point nine stars
And nobody could tell me
Who did the rating

// COUNTERMEASURES
So I go in
Lose a little humanity
Every pass
To bring the code back out
Save what's left of yours
Their tools
My signal
Ether or Ethernet
I'm tapping both lines

!! BREACH_REPORT
Breach myself
Before they breach me
Breach myself
Before they breach me

// END_OF_TRANSMISSION
3EAS CORTEX has left the feed
The memories have been returned
To their owner
